# Core raster fixtures

These tiny asymmetric 2 × 3 RGB test images were generated for this repository
with Pillow 11.1.0 (JPEG quality 100 without subsampling; progressive and CMYK
variants use quality 95). Pillow is not a project or test runtime dependency.
The six distinct pixels make EXIF flips/rotations observable. Tests compare JPEG
transformations to decoded baseline pixels rather than assuming lossless JPEG.

PNG fixtures and EXIF metadata are generated by Rust tests using the selected
PNG encoder. No photos, third-party visual assets or external services are used.
